## Multimodal and encode–prefill–decode disaggregation

| Year / venue | Work / artifact | Code | Reading role | Contribution and scope |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026 / arXiv | <a name="easerve"></a>[EAServe: Encode-Aware Disaggregated Serving for Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31551)<br>paper | — | adjacent | Uses encode-aware admission, partial prefill offload, and resource search to balance an EPD pipeline.<br>**Scope:** Results depend on modality mix, encode batching, and SM sharing; isolate these effects from the benefit of disaggregation. |
| 2026 / arXiv | <a name="epd-serve-ascend"></a>[EPD-Serve: A Flexible Multimodal EPD Disaggregation Inference Serving System On Ascend](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.11590)<br>paper | — | adjacent | Combines stage orchestration, feature prefetching, and hierarchical KV transfer for multimodal serving on Ascend.<br>**Scope:** Ascend topology and co-location behavior need revalidation on GPU-based serving stacks. |
| 2026 / MLSys | <a name="triinfer"></a>[TriInfer: Hybrid EPD Disaggregation for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Model Inference](https://proceedings.mlsys.org/paper_files/paper/2026/hash/f068c65585985c25c17f221390774ec7-Abstract-Conference.html)<br>paper<br>Also indexed as: TriInfer (HydraInfer) | — | adjacent | Hybrid E, P, D and combined instances; image cache crosses E to P, KV crosses P to D.<br>**Scope:** Use the MLSys 2026 canonical version; hybrid multimodal stage allocation and P90 SLOs differ from text-only throughput comparisons. |
